mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", u.login_id AS "teacherName", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_status AS "certificationStatus", a.attachment_ref AS "attachmentRef", a.achievement_detail AS "achievementDetail", d.special_lecture_start_date AS "specialLectureStartDate", d.special_lecture_end_date AS "specialLectureEndDate", d.mock_exam_question_period AS "mockExamQuestionPeriod", a.created_at AS "createdAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM education_achievements a JOIN employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND CURRENT_DATE >= m.effective_start_date AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR CURRENT_DATE <= m.effective_end_date) ORDER BY m.organization_code

SELECT p.evaluation_year FROM input_period_settings p WHERE p.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND p.active_yn = 'Y' AND (p.organization_code IS NULL OR p.organization_code = #{organizationCode}) AND (p.user_type_code IS NULL OR p.user_type_code = 'FACULTY') AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP BETWEEN p.start_at AND p.end_at ORDER BY p.setting_id

SELECT m.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", m.management_item_name AS "managementItemName", m.required_yn AS "requiredYn", m.data_type AS "dataType", m.teacher_editable_yn AS "teacherEditableYn", e.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear" FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_rule_versions r ON r.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id WHERE a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND r.version_status != 'DISCARDED' AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} ORDER BY e.evaluation_year DESC, m.sort_order, m.management_item_id
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = btrim(#{body.managementItemCode}), achievement_date = #{body.achievementDate}, attachment_ref = #{attachments}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_RATE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
